name: Libreoffice
description: LibreOffice is a free and powerful office suite.
composeYaml:
services:
  libreoffice:
    image: 'lscr.io/linuxserver/libreoffice:latest'
    environment:
      - 'PUID=${PUID:-1000}'
      - 'PGID=${PGID:-1000}'
      - 'TZ=${TZ:-Etc/UTC}'
    volumes:
      - 'libreoffice-config:/config'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - '-q'
        - '--spider'
        - 'http://localhost:3000'
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
